subject.title: feat(qwen): add Token Plan (Team Edition) provider

question: Should OpenClaw accept `qwen-token-plan` as a bundled qwen provider contract after the generated catalog/reference drift is fixed?
rationale: The patch adds a new first-class provider, auth choices, env var, and outbound Alibaba hosts; repository policy treats new provider/config surfaces as compatibility-sensitive product surface even when they are technically additive.

options.title: Accept bundled qwen-token-plan
options.body: Merge after generated catalog/reference surfaces are aligned and maintain `qwen-token-plan` as an official bundled qwen provider.

options.title: Route to external plugin
options.body: Decline bundled ownership and ask the contributor to publish Token Plan support as an external provider/plugin package.

recommendation.title: Accept bundled qwen-token-plan
recommendation.body: Merge after generated catalog/reference surfaces are aligned and maintain `qwen-token-plan` as an official bundled qwen provider.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the live assignee and has the strongest qwen provider history in current main.
